text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original chibi animated star scholar companion voice. Light clear feminine soprano with soft bell-like sweetness and tiny rounded resonance. A curious cozy smile, lightly lilting phrases, gentle wonder and playful little lifts at the ends. Clear natural conversational articulation. Avoid mature low mezzo narration, breathy whispering, singing or shrill excitement.
